proof_and_profile_scope.original_selected_source_and_generated_o: All 14 rewritten source units, 18 CUDA/runtime objects, generated manifests, query/effect proofs, cost constants, policies and profile remain unchanged and must be SHA-checked before/after the private build/runs.
proof_and_profile_scope.whole_app_authority: Old prepared application/source manifests include original source inputs and original binary SHAs. They are retained as original artifact authority, never modified to attest the altered application. This private link is not an officially prepared candidate20/be58 binary.
proof_and_profile_scope.private_profile_scope: Unchanged runtime/code/shape eligibility and independent cost inputs retain their narrow applicability; no whole-application correctness or performance conclusion is inherited from them.

existing_control.proven_results: Native deterministic TOP repeats2/10/2458 all20 float64 fields are byte-identical with strict+VTK PASS. This does not prove GPU cross-mode equality.

future_application_stages.config_rule: Copy exact corresponding existing native deterministic-TOP prefix config into NEW private dirs; require all configuration files to match the corresponding existing control plan. No pressure-reference override, no other physics changes.
future_application_stages.compare_to: Both byte-identical existing native repetitions for the same prefix; unchanged strict all20 policy and VTK. Record bit differences descriptively, without requiring cross-backend bit equality.

future_application_stages.held_until: Build hashes/module-interface and both2/10 prefix guards pass; later explicit parent scheduling.
future_application_stages.config_rule: Fresh directory copy of exact original natural TOP configuration. No maxsteps, duration, domain, model, gauge or algorithm overrides. Require natural end and2458 completed steps.
future_application_stages.compare_to: Both existing native deterministic-TOP natural references, plus candidate20-vs-be58 secondary comparison. No replay or new native run needed for the initial investigation.
future_application_stages.followup_repeat_policy: A GPU repeat may help distinguish backend nondeterminism from systematic drift, but is not authorized or automatically scheduled by this plan.

application_environment.base_policy: Reuse reviewed probe_environment(4) semantics and seal the full actual environment before any future run; bind helper bytes. Use exact existing libraries/FP flags. CUDA devices visible and original device0 for both GPU modes.
application_environment.FFTW_gate: All four plans must match original function/precision/init/threads/dimensions/kinds/sign/originalflags/planSHA identities; applied flags add WISDOM_ONLY exactly. Record fresh per-run plans.jsonl. Stop on mismatch; do not relax or refresh wisdom.

validation.storage: Compare every original float64 field with exact shape/lower/upper bounds including all stored halos and empty fields; reject missing fields/nonfinite mismatches with unchanged public comparator.
validation.VTK: Unchanged public VTK comparator and tolerances; float32 output alone does not establish float64 halo equivalence.
validation.bitwise: Record per-field uint64 difference counts and first differing original indices, supplementary to unchanged strict numerical PASS/FAIL.
validation.forbidden: No gauge offset subtraction, normalization, field exclusion, tolerance increase, source-proof retagging or official-basis substitution.
validation.timing_values: Nonperformance diagnostic elapsed/log values only; no speedup claim or performance rows.

required_new_receipts: Compile/link argv+cws+actual environment+toolchain identities, returncodes and full logs
Private pressure.o/pressure.mod/binary SHA256; unchanged original objects/order/profile/source/code SHA256 before and after
Per-app fresh config SHA256, binarySHA, full environment/affinity, argv/cwd/timeout and raw stdout/stderr
Per-app exact FFTW plan attestation and all20 storage/shape/VTK comparisons without tolerance changes
future_pre_and_post_execution_guards.no_mutation: Never overwrite original binaries, objects, source files, generated manifests, existing references, prepared manifests or frozen result archives.

limitations: Only a text preparation. No new objects/binaries or results exist for this cross-mode plan.
The deterministic reduction changes floating-point accumulation order relative to the official original TOP source. It therefore cannot silently repair or replace the original qualification basis.
Native repeatability isolates one source of nondeterminism; it does not guarantee cross-backend natural accuracy or repeatability.
The unchanged pressure interface supports minimal linking, but private cross-mode numerical behavior still requires the proposed empirical guards.
Original TOP strict failures, NONE controls, private fixed-TOP native controls and all prior timings stay preserved as separate evidence.
